rules.name: Snow and Ice Classification
rules.syntax: Ms'Snow, persistence units months, persistence period 9-12 OR Ms'Ice, persistence units months, persistence period 9-12
rules.description:
Mandatory standard Snow with persistence unit of months and a persistence period of 9-12 
OR 
Mandatory standard Ice with persistence unit of months and a persistence period of 9-12

rules.name: Herbaceous Wetland Classification
rules.syntax: MsL'Herbaceous Growth Forms, cover 10-100%, natural or seminatural & MsL'Water Body, persistence unit months, persistence period 2-12
rules.description:
Mandatory standard Layering of Herbaceous Growth Forms with cover of 10-100% and natural or semi-natural
AND
Mandatory standard Layering of Water Bodies with persistence unit of months and a persistence period of 2-12
